name: EOSR WP-MVP-0002 Closure Bootstrap

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - eosr/close-wp-mvp-0002-bootstrap

permissions:
  contents: write

env:
  EOS_ACTOR: thomascarter613

jobs:
  close:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 35
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with: {fetch-depth: 0}

      - name: Enter exact accepted-review baseline
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          BASE_SHA="d8f687a5665ea4551de63ba4a17d14bde5167ddc"
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
          git fetch origin main
          test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$BASE_SHA"
          git reset --hard "$BASE_SHA"
          test ! -e .github/workflows/eosr-close-wp-mvp-0002-bootstrap.yml
          test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"

      - name: Reconcile exactly seven accepted criteria
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          p=Path('engineering/work-packets/WP-MVP-0002.md')
          text=p.read_text()
          before=text.count('- [ ]')
          assert before == 7, before
          text=text.replace('- [ ]','- [x]')
          assert text.count('- [x]') == 7
          assert '- [ ]' not in text
          p.write_text(text)
          PY

      - name: Refresh evidence while WP remains IN_REVIEW
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          ./scripts/eos validate WP-MVP-0001 --profile wp
          ./scripts/eos validate WP-MVP-0002 --profile wp --execution EXEC-0004
          ./scripts/eos verify --strict
          ./scripts/eos state status
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --write
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check
          ./scripts/eos gate explain WP_CLOSE WP-MVP-0002

      - name: Close WP-MVP-0002
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          ./scripts/eos close WP-MVP-0002 \
            --reason "Human closure authorization following accepted EOSR engineering review merged through PR #200 at d8f687a5665ea4551de63ba4a17d14bde5167ddc."
          ./scripts/eos verify --strict
          ./scripts/eos state status
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --write
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check

      - name: Assert closure invariants
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import csv, json
          wp=Path('engineering/work-packets/WP-MVP-0002.md').read_text()
          assert '**Status:** CLOSED' in wp
          section=wp.split('## Acceptance criteria',1)[1].split('## Implementation boundary',1)[0]
          assert section.count('- [x]')==7 and '- [ ]' not in section
          review=Path('engineering/reviews/WP-MVP-0002-REVIEW.md').read_text()
          assert '**Decision:** ACCEPTED' in review
          rows={r['id']:r for r in csv.DictReader(open('.eos/work-packets.tsv'),delimiter='\t')}
          assert rows['WP-MVP-0002']['status']=='CLOSED', rows['WP-MVP-0002']
          events=[json.loads(line) for line in Path('.eos/events.jsonl').read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]
          closes=[e for e in events if e.get('target')=='WP-MVP-0002' and e.get('action')=='close' and e.get('event_type')=='STATE_TRANSITION']
          assert len(closes)==1, closes
          assert closes[0]['from_state']=='IN_REVIEW' and closes[0]['to_state']=='CLOSED', closes[0]
          evidence=list(csv.DictReader(open('.eos/evidence.tsv'),delimiter='\t'))
          wp2=[r for r in evidence if r['target']=='WP-MVP-0002' and r['status']!='SUPERSEDED']
          assert len(wp2)==3 and all(r['status']=='VALIDATED' and r['execution']=='EXEC-0004' for r in wp2), wp2
          assert next(r for r in wp2 if r['validator']=='execution-acceptance')['result']=='PASSED'
          PY
          if git diff --name-only | grep -E '^(crates/|src/|.*\.rs$|tools/eos/|product/|architecture/|specifications/|engineering/work-cycles/|engineering/increments/)'; then
            echo 'Unexpected product/governing change in closure.' >&2; exit 1
          fi
          git status --short
          git diff --stat

      - name: Commit prove stable and publish closure
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          FINAL_BRANCH="eosr/close-wp-mvp-0002"
          git config user.name 'PMB CI'
          git config user.email 'ci@pmb.test'
          git add -A
          git commit -m 'chore(eosr): close WP-MVP-0002'
          ./scripts/eos verify --strict
          ./scripts/eos state status
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check
          test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD^)" = "d8f687a5665ea4551de63ba4a17d14bde5167ddc"
          if git ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin "$FINAL_BRANCH" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'Final closure branch exists' >&2; exit 1; fi
          git push origin "HEAD:refs/heads/$FINAL_BRANCH"
